## Heads up

- **Signed in with an email? You'll be asked for a PIN.** Accounts now need
  a 6-digit PIN after the emailed code. The first time this version starts,
  the panel asks you to choose one, and your saved storage keys are moved
  into a copy the server can't read. Older versions (v1.1.1 and before)
  can no longer sign in or sync keys, so update every computer on your
  account.

## What's new

- **Use it without an account.** The sign-in screen now leads with **Use
  without an account**: your storage keys stay on this computer only. To
  set up another computer, use **Settings → Export keys**, which saves them
  in a file locked with a passphrase, then **Import keys** on the other one.
  The hosted email account is still there, as the second option.

- **Email, code, then PIN.** Signing in with an email now takes the emailed
  code and your PIN. Your PIN encrypts your storage keys on your computer
  before they're synced, so the server only holds a copy it can't open on
  its own. Five wrong PINs lock sign-in for 15 minutes. **Forgot PIN**
  sends a new code; it deletes the synced keys and signs your other
  computers out.

- **Drime first, then any S3 storage.** Drime is the main place to back up
  to. For a second copy, or instead of Drime, pick Cloudflare R2, Backblaze
  B2, Amazon S3, or any other S3-compatible service by its endpoint.

- **Pack small files to stay under free limits.** S3 providers count every
  upload and listing against monthly limits. With **Pack small files** on,
  files under 4 MB go into 16 MB zip packs, so a backup of thousands of
  small files makes far fewer requests. Packing is set per destination: on
  by default for S3, off for Drime. Restores, deleted-file recovery and
  second copies work the same either way, and turning it off later keeps
  older packed backups readable.

- **Copy a Drime folder to S3, whatever backs it up.** Already back up to
  Drime with another app? Under **Settings → Drime folders**, add the
  folder and r2backup keeps a copy of it on your S3 storage, without you
  switching backup tools. In the terminal: `r2b mirror drime add`.
